{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]]
==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] [[Cookbook:Hot Dog|hot dog]]
* 1 strip [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 1 slice American or [[Cookbook:Cheddar_Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 1 bun

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep fryer]] to 355°F.
# Wrap bacon around the hot dog, securing at each end with a [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]].
# When oil reaches 355°F, lower wrapped hot dog into fryer.
# Heat [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] and fry one egg.
# Place cooked egg on a small plate.
# Open bun and place onto frying pan on low heat or in toaster oven to lightly toast.
# When bacon is firm and crispy, remove hot dog from oil.
# Place slice of cheese onto egg and microwave for 7-10 seconds.
# Place egg and cheese on to bun.
# Remove toothpicks from hot dog, and add to bun.
# Add condiments and serve.
